entries.title: Restore endpoint POST /api/db/restore {path, targetRev, expectedRev}: reverse-apply diff reconstruction, 409 stale_rev, 422 unreconstructable, forward mutation through the standard envelope (op 'restore', audit-chained)
entries.evidence: H2 (4b2a3dd). reconstructStateAtRev (pure reverse-apply; gap OR delete-in-range -> 422 firstMissingRev, never a best-guess) + readVersionsForPath (partition-scoped READ, census stays 3) + POST /api/db/restore (VIEWER 403, 404, 409 stale_rev, 400 invalid target, 422 unreconstructable, else commit via mutateInternal op:'restore' with restore provenance). H1 (8b9c70a) also extracted the pure assembleEnvelope proving BOTH mutate + mutateBatch emit a hash-chained version doc (imported entities carry a genesis version).
entries.test: tests/server/restore.test.ts + versions-write.test.ts; hostile-judged SAFE (2 rounds counting H6a)
entries.lesson: Restore is a forward mutation, never a history rewrite - the chain must extend, not bend. The SERVER reconstructs; the client never sends a snapshot it could forge.

entries.test: app/src/components/product/HistoryDrawer.test.tsx (gating/action/409/422) + versionRead.test.ts (canRestore/provenance)
entries.lesson: UI built ahead of its endpoint is a latent contract - finish it or it rots into a false affordance.

entries.lesson: The formula-injection guard belongs in the shared table(), so every current AND future export inherits it.

entries.title: Audit-chain-across-restore fixture: /api/db/audit/verify green after a restore cycle
entries.evidence: H2 (4b2a3dd). restore.test.ts HI-04: a create->update->restore chain (op:'restore' + restore provenance) verifies green via verifyAuditChain with the tail anchor; tampering the restore provenance breaks the chain (provenance is sealed).
entries.test: tests/server/restore.test.ts HI-04 block
entries.lesson: A restore extends the chain like any mutation; the tamper-evidence must survive it.

entries.title: Provenance sealed in the audit hash WITHOUT forking the chain (AI/voice/restore attestation: fleet-sourced model id, citation refs, confidence, authoredBy)
entries.evidence: H4 (0db95c0). computeAuditHash seals provenance CONDITIONALLY (present -> tamper-evident; absent -> byte-identical to legacy, chain NOT forked); provenance deliberately NOT in AUDIT_HASH_FIELDS (an always-null would fork every legacy chain). Bundle audit-chain-shared.cjs rebuilt in-sync. Provenance envelope published to the orchestration CONTRACTS row.
entries.test: shared/src/audit/chain.test.ts (26): no-fork (absent===legacy hash), present-covered, strip/alter->hash_mismatch, mixed legacy+provenanced chain; versions-write.test.ts H4 integration
entries.lesson: To add a hashed field without forking a live chain, seal it CONDITIONALLY - absence must change nothing.

entries.title: HITL: an AI/voice-authored governed change requires a resolvable citation, enforced at the write seam (envelope 422 citation_required)
entries.evidence: H6b (b4a55b8). requiresCitation (authoredBy in {ai,voice}) + hasResolvableCitation (non-empty, non-placeholder) in the envelope sync prelude; CITATION_REQUIRED->422 in /mutate + /mutateBatch. Non-breaking: import sets no provenance (IMPORT-CERTIFIED safe), human/restore/vote unaffected. Only surfaces that DECLARE ai/voice authoring are bound.
entries.test: tests/server/hitl.test.ts (in test:gates -> deploy-blocking); hostile-judged SAFE (import not broken)
entries.lesson: Enforce grounding at the write SEAM, not just the reviewed UI - a script or future agent must not slip an ungrounded AI change past it.
